title: How Much Does Jellyfish Software Pricing Cost?
summary: Jellyfish pricing structures often require direct sales contact, making budget estimation difficult for engineering leaders. Compare actual costs here.
body_markdown:
## Automating Engineering Metrics Reporting With Activepieces


Around whichever metrics tool you buy, there is copying that Activepieces can automate, the Slack digest and the finance sheet. It doesn't replace Jellyfish's engineering data model or its finance reporting.


### The hidden manual labor of using Jellyfish


Whoever signs the Jellyfish quote, someone on your team still pastes a weekly number into Slack and re-keys allocation figures into the spreadsheet finance actually reads.


That time is a quiet cross-subsidy. If you're pricing the tool honestly, price that labor too.


### How automated workflows process data


Activepieces reaches every model provider a company uses among its 750+ integrations, and pushes the combined spend into the sheet finance already reads.


A trigger starts a flow, and each following step does one job, such as calling an HTTP endpoint, posting a message or writing a row.


Its published pricing page lists 1 credit per flow run, any number of steps, so a ten-step digest costs the same as the two-step workaround it replaced.


Billing by the run rather than the task means you can build granular, reliable flows without the per-step tax found on Zapier or Make.


The run is the meter, not the steps inside it, which is why you can cost this layer before you talk to anyone, unlike the[Jellyfish](https://jellyfish.co/newsroom/jellyfish-announces-series-a-funding-led-by-accel-wing-venture-capital/) quote.


It is a different job, revoking an access token when an instance stops, but the run view below shows the shape every reporting flow shares.


A trigger step feeds an HTTP request step, the second step's method, URL, header and body are all visible in its panel, and the run log marks each step done with its input and output beside it.


### What the automation cannot do


What follows from that is a limit. Activepieces moves numbers between systems. It doesn't compute cycle time, attribute engineering effort to a budget line, or produce the finance view you'd be paying Jellyfish for.


MoneyGram and Moneypenny run Activepieces in production to handle these flows under central governance.


The same enterprise features (including SSO, SCIM, custom RBAC, audit logs, and release management) available in the managed cloud are also provided in the self-hosted air-gapped edition, so regulated teams maintain full control without losing capability.
